title: Bug reproduced: factor(expand((x-1)*(y-1)), extension=[I]) returns x-1 instead of (x-1)*(y-1)
Bug reproduced in checkout sympy-19040-nopanel: factor(expand((x-1)*(y-1)), extension=[I]) -> x - 1, missing (y-1)
Reproduced: factor(expand((x-1)*(y-1)), extension=[I]) returns x - 1, dropping (y - 1)
Root cause: dmp_sqf_part/dmp_sqf_p gcd only w.r.t. x0, dropping factors not involving x0; dmp_ext_factor/dmp_sqf_norm also use dmp_compose where dmp_shift is needed
target: sympy/polys/sqfreetools.py: dmp_sqf_part, dmp_sqf_p; factortools.py: dmp_ext_factor, dmp_sqf_norm
evidence_refs: run_command: dmp_gcd(f, dmp_diff(f,1,u,K)) = y-1 dense rep; f//gcd = x-1
